entries.title: Research Intern
entries.organization: Nanomaterials and Energy Storage System (NESS) Lab, CUET
bullets: Investigated black phosphorus-based nanocomposites as high-performance anode materials for lithium-ion batteries
Explored transition-metal-oxide-rich steel slag as a sustainable precursor for lithium-ion battery anode materials
Principal Investigator: Dr. Md. Arafat Rahman

entries.title: Undergraduate Research Thesis
entries.organization: Nanomaterials and Energy Storage System (NESS) Lab, CUET
bullets: Synthesized porous nanostructured iron oxide from TMO-rich industrial steel slag through ball milling, chemical and thermal processing routes
Fabricated iron oxide-based anodes and assembled lithium-ion coin cells for electrochemical evaluation
Characterized morphology and phase composition using XRD and SEM
Conducted GCD, CV, and EIS testing to evaluate battery performance

entries.title: Experimental
bullets: Dry chemical synthesis, thermal processing, powder processing, nanomaterial engineering, air-sensitive material handling
Instrumentation: CV, EIS, GCD, SEM, XRD, ball mill, centrifuge, argon glovebox, 3D printing
